sources.sections: Institution identity; routes; accommodation inventory; dining; steward service; live music; restored carriages
sources.title: Venice Simplon-Orient-Express
sources.note: Primary institution source. Presents the train as a luxury overnight rail-hospitality product with restored sleeper carriages, fully inclusive dining, 24-hour steward service and routes across multiple European cities.

sources.sections: Journey inventory; route; duration; cabin-linked pricing; availability-sensitive pricing
sources.title: Venice Simplon-Orient-Express Journeys
sources.note: Discovery and commitment source showing multiple routes, durations, cabin types and price states rather than one uniform train product.

sources.sections: Paris-Venice itinerary; approximate timings; railway constraints; accommodation; transfers; steward service; dining
sources.title: Paris to Venice 2026
sources.note: Representative overnight journey. Includes one night aboard, station/accommodation transfers, 24-hour steward service and specified meals. Published timings are approximate because the train is subject to national railway constraints.

sources.sections: Paris-Istanbul itinerary; nights aboard; cities; excursions; dining; steward service; railway constraints
sources.title: Paris to Istanbul 2026
sources.note: Multi-day comparator showing that one sold journey can combine nights aboard with city tours, a Danube cruise and other off-train components while railway timing remains externally constrained.

sources.sections: Journey duration; luggage; dress; Wi-Fi; dietary requirements; passports; children; dining seating; insurance; accessibility
sources.title: Venice Simplon-Orient-Express FAQs
sources.note: Primary practical-boundary source. Distinguishes hand, cabin and through luggage; identifies unavailable-through-journey baggage; requires advance dietary notice; makes dining seating confirmation onboard; places passport readiness on travellers; and directs reduced-mobility guests to journey-specific assistance.

sources.sections: Historic Cabins; Suites; Grand Suites; L'Observatoire; bathrooms; privacy; space
sources.title: Venice Simplon-Orient-Express Accommodation
sources.note: Accommodation-tier source. Historic Cabins use shared restrooms, Suites add private en-suite facilities, Grand Suites add larger residential spaces, and L'Observatoire constitutes an exclusive private carriage.

sources.sections: Grand Suite configuration; private dining; butler service; pre-journey planning; transfers
sources.title: Grand Suites
sources.note: Shows that cabin tier changes more than physical accommodation: Grand Suites include private in-cabin dining, 24-hour butler service, personalised pre-journey planning and private arrival/departure transfers.

sources.sections: Exclusive carriage; steward service; private dining; beverages; transfers; private spaces
sources.title: L'Observatoire
sources.note: Highest-tier accommodation source. L'Observatoire is an entire private carriage with 24-hour service, private dining and transfers to/from the train and accommodation within the published radius.

sources.sections: Breakfast; lunch; dinner; wines; Bar Car; cabin service; restaurant cars; entertainment
sources.title: Dining & Entertainment
sources.note: Dining source documenting onboard restaurant cars, cabin service, included meal formats, wine service, the Bar Car and live entertainment.

sources.sourceDate: Current EEA and UK consumer booking conditions inspected 2026-10-14
sources.sections: Contract formation; deposits; final payment; special requests; changes; cancellations; independent providers; passport and visa obligations
sources.title: Trains & Cruises EEA & UK Consumer Booking Conditions
sources.note: Jurisdiction-bounded booking source. Deposit and balance rules vary by journey type; a binding contract follows confirmation; special requests are not guaranteed; changes are classified; independent travel providers can supply components; passport and visa compliance remains the traveller's responsibility.

sources.sections: Applicability; carriers; force majeure; changes; complaints; luggage; liability; supplier and railway conditions
sources.title: Trains & Cruises Conditions of Carriage
sources.note: Responsibility-boundary source. Identifies VSOE, national/local railway bodies and other carriers; defines complaint routes and luggage claims; and incorporates operating-carrier and international-convention responsibilities into carriage.

sources.sections: Travel data; passport and visa data; preferences; dietary and mobility information; personalisation; third-party providers; retention
sources.title: Belmond Privacy Policy
sources.note: Data-relationship source. Covers booking and travel information, passport/visa data, preferences, sensitive dietary or mobility information, personalisation and sharing with Belmond entities and third-party providers involved in transfers, excursions and other requested services.

sources.sections: Reservation identity; route; passengers; departure/arrival; cabin selection; price; Historic Cabin facilities
sources.title: Sample Venice Simplon-Orient-Express Cabin Selection
sources.note: Time-bounded booking-flow example only. Shows route/date/passenger/cabin objects and a Historic Cabin price state; it is not evidence that inventory or price remains unchanged.

sources.sections: Carriage history; restoration; relaunch; individual carriage provenance; heritage narrative
sources.title: Venice Simplon-Orient-Express: Our History
sources.note: First-party historical/editorial source. Documents the provenance and restoration narrative of individual carriages and the 1982 relaunch. Useful for story and heritage analysis, not independent historical verification.
